# v3.4.0 Welcome to Immich `v3.4.0`! This release adds workflow improvements, JPEG XL support, tags on mobile (finally?!), a plethora of security fixes and other improvements and bug fixes. ## Highlights * Make/model display changes * Workflow improvements * Security fixes * Performance improvements ### Make/model display changes Manufacturer names are sometimes duplicated in the camera make, but many of these have now been fixed. ![Camera make & model values before and after the change.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7b17987-953e-433b-b679-fdc4d4484edd " =1120x186") ### Workflows improvements There are two new match types for the EXIF metadata filter, `missing` and `present`. Use these properties instead of a pattern when you only need to know if the property is present or not. ![Workflows "Add step" modal showing the EXIF metadata filter with the match type dropdown open](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e61301b4-c5ab-4068-84e0-f40a37aa4d85 " =655x810") Further, there is a new trigger to run a workflow once OCR processing has finished. ![Workflows select trigger modal showing the new "Asset OCR Extraction" trigger](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc9e15ea-a4bf-4211-b95a-6e1258da783b " =619x432") This is particularly useful in combination with the new OCR text filter. ![Workflows "Add step" modal showing the OCR text filter](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0bef018a-fff0-458d-97b4-8505dee0873e " =620x788") In combination, you can for instance build a workflow that automatically adds receipts to an album, based on typical keywords one would find on a receipt. ### Security fixes Thanks to @bo0tzz for a whole batch of security fixes and improvements, including a CSP change which now no longer ships with `unsafe-inline`. As always, please consider supporting the project. 🎉 Cheers! 🎉 ## Support Immich

If you find the project helpful, you can support Immich by purchasing a product key at or our merchandise at ---- And as always, bugs are fixed, and many other improvements also come with this release. ## What's Changed ### 🔒 Security * fix(server): apply shared link metadata visibility in asset mapper by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): anchor plugin allowedHosts matching by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): require upload access for checksum duplicate check by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): escape template variables in custom email templates by @bo0tzz in * fix(cli): only act on files that were sent in the bulk upload check by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): restrict partner timeline requests to timeline assets by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): sanitize EXIF template variables and tighten storage path check by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): only serve edited assets to shared links in archive downloads by @bo0tzz in * fix(server): only set OAuth cookies for server-generated state by @bo0tzz in *
